verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel, I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.pt: Não fareis segundo as obras da terra do Egito, em que habitastes; nem fareis segundo as obras da terra de Canaã, para a qual eu vos levo; nem andareis segundo os seus estatutos.
verses.en_web: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived: and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
verses.en_bbe: You may not do those things which were done in the land of Egypt where you were living; and you may not do those things which are done in the land of Canaan where I am taking you, or be guided in your behaviour by their rules.

verses.en: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Os meus preceitos observareis, e os meus estatutos guardareis, para andardes neles. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: You shall do my ordinances, and you shall keep my statutes, and walk in them: I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: But you are to be guided by my decisions and keep my rules, and be guided by them: I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Guardareis, pois, os meus estatutos e as minhas ordenanças, pelas quais o homem, observando-as, viverá. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances; which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So keep my rules and my decisions, which, if a man does them, will be life to him: I am the Lord.

verses.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Nenhum de vós se chegará àquela que lhe é próxima por sangue, para descobrir a sua nudez. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex connection with anyone who is a near relation: I am the Lord.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez de teu pai, nem tampouco a de tua mãe; ela é tua mãe, não descobrirás a sua nudez.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex relations with your father or your mother: she is your mother, you may not take her.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez da mulher de teu pai; é nudez de teu pai.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not have sex relations with your father's wife: she is your father's.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.pt: A nudez de tua irmã por parte de pai ou por parte de mãe, quer nascida em casa ou fora de casa, não a descobrirás.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home, or born abroad.
verses.en_bbe: You may not take your sister, the daughter of your father or of your mother, wherever her birth took place, among you or in another country.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.pt: Nem tampouco descobrirás a nudez da filha de teu filho, ou da filha de tua filha; porque é tua nudez.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness: for theirs is your own nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, for they are part of yourself;

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.pt: A nudez da filha da mulher de teu pai, gerada de teu pai, a qual é tua irmã, não a descobrirás.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
verses.en_bbe: Or your father's wife's daughter, the child of your father, for she is your sister.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez da irmã de teu pai; ela é parenta chegada de teu pai.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex connection with your father's sister, for she is your father's near relation.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez da irmã de tua mãe, pois ela é parenta chegada de tua mãe.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex connection with your mother's sister, for she is your mother's near relation.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez do irmão de teu pai; não te chegarás à sua mulher; ela é tua tia.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex relations with the wife of your father's brother, for she is of your family;

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez de tua nora; ,ela é mulher de teu filho; não descobrirás a sua nudez.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law: she is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: Or with your daughter-in-law, for she is your son's wife, and you may not take her.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez da mulher de teu irmão; é a nudez de teu irmão.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex relations with your brother's wife, for she is your brother's.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.pt: Não descobrirás a nudez duma mulher e de sua filha. Não tomarás a filha de seu filho, nem a filha de sua filha, para descobrir a sua nudez; são parentas chegadas; é maldade.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.en_bbe: You may not take as wife a woman and her daughter, or her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, for they are of one family: it is an act of shame.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.pt: E não tomarás uma mulher juntamente com sua irmã, durante a vida desta, para tornar-lha rival, descobrindo a sua nudez ao lado da outra.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not take as wife a woman and at the same time her sister, to be in competition with her in her life-time.

verses.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.pt: Também não te chegarás a mulher enquanto for impura em virtude da sua imundícia, para lhe descobrir a nudez.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not go near a woman or have sex relations with her when she is unclean, at her regular time.

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.pt: Nem te deitarás com a mulher de teu próximo, contaminando-te com ela.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not have sex relations with your neighbour's wife, making yourself unclean with her.

verses.en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Não oferecerás a Moloque nenhum dos teus filhos, fazendo-o passar pelo fogo; nem profanarás o nome de teu Deus. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not make any of your children go through the fire as an offering to Molech, and you may not put shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.

verses.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.pt: Não te deitarás com varão, como se fosse mulher; é abominação.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not lie with a man, as with a woman. That is detestable.
verses.en_bbe: You may not have sex relations with men, as you do with women: it is a disgusting thing.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.pt: Nem te deitarás com animal algum, contaminando-te com ele; nem a mulher se porá perante um animal, para ajuntar-se com ele; é confusão.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
verses.en_bbe: And you may not have sex relations with a beast, making yourself unclean with it; and a woman may not give herself to a beast: it is an unnatural act.

verses.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.pt: Não vos contamineis com nenhuma dessas coisas, porque com todas elas se contaminaram as nações que eu expulso de diante de vós;
verses.en_web: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
verses.en_bbe: Do not make yourself unclean in any of these ways; for so have those nations whom I am driving out from before you made themselves unclean:

verses.en: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.pt: e, porquanto a terra está contaminada, eu visito sobre ela a sua iniqüidade, e a terra vomita os seus habitantes.
verses.en_web: The land was defiled: therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
verses.en_bbe: And the land itself has become unclean; so that I have sent on it the reward of its wrongdoing, and the land itself puts out those who are living in it.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.pt: Vós, pois, guardareis os meus estatutos e os meus preceitos, e nenhuma dessas abominações fareis, nem o natural, nem o estrangeiro que peregrina entre vós
verses.en_web: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;
verses.en_bbe: So then keep my rules and my decisions, and do not do any of these disgusting things, those of you who are Israelites by birth, or any others who are living with you:

verses.en: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.pt: (porque todas essas abominações cometeram os homens da terra, que nela estavam antes de vós, e a terra ficou contaminada);
verses.en_web: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled);
verses.en_bbe: (For all these disgusting things were done by the men of this country who were there before you, and the land has been made unclean by them;)

verses.en: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.pt: para que a terra não seja contaminada por vós e não vos vomite também a vós, como vomitou a nação que nela estava antes de vós.
verses.en_web: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.en_bbe: So that the land may not put you out from it, when you make it unclean, as it put out the nations which were there before you.

verses.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.pt: Pois qualquer que cometer alguma dessas abominações, sim, aqueles que as cometerem serão extirpados do seu povo.
verses.en_web: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.en_bbe: For all those who do any of these disgusting things will be cut off from among their people.

verses.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Portanto guardareis o meu mandamento, de modo que não caiais em nenhum desses abomináveis costumes que antes de vós foram seguidos, e para que não vos contamineis com eles. Eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs, which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am Yahweh your God.’”
verses.en_bbe: So then, keep my orders, so that you may not do any of these disgusting things which were done before you, or make yourselves unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.
